release-rollouts.title: Dependency-ordered rollout
release-rollouts.boundary: Use the original individually approved plans. Dispatch downstream steps only after prerequisite deployment health gates are satisfied. Rollout, effect and health are separate facts; cross-environment release is not atomic.
release-rollouts.start_help: Review dependencies, human approval of each original plan and fixed run identities first. This starts protected subflows in the single Go DAG; it neither creates nor approves new deployment plans.
release-rollouts.start_ack: I reviewed all original plans, dependencies and reserved runs in this preview. Start this rollout.
release-rollouts.pause_help: No new steps are dispatched while paused. Started child runs continue to drain. Actual effect, health and stop acknowledgements remain separate facts.
release-rollouts.resume_help: Reconcile any unknown original operation, then preview current authority, approvals, environments and run version. Successful steps are retained; failed non-idempotent steps are not blindly retried.
release-rollouts.resume_scope: Continue incomplete protected steps only when current gates allow it. Effects already produced remain; unknown results need reconciliation and known failures require a newly reviewed plan.
release-rollouts.resume_ack: I reviewed the current resume preview. Retain completed steps and existing effects, then continue only allowed steps.
release-rollouts.cancel_help: Propagate real cancellation requests to started child runs without automatically rolling back effects. Review original stop acknowledgements and actual deployment state; requesting cancellation does not prove a stop.
release-rollouts.cancel_ack: I understand cancellation is not rollback. Original operations and actual stop results still need review.
release-rollouts.page_scope: Page snapshot: {{loaded}} / {{total}}. Current details refresh from persisted events.
release-rollouts.open_plan: View original plan and human approval
release-rollouts.recover_help: Retain the original request, fixed runs and operation identity. Recovery shows current facts and does not rewind progress to an old receipt state.
release-rollouts.access_changed: Access changed. Protected rollout and run facts have been cleared.
release-rollouts.invalid_read: The response does not match this project, set, plan group, original run or exact source.
release-rollouts.crypto_unavailable: This browser cannot verify fixed-source hashes. Use a secure connection or a local loopback address.
release-rollouts.draft_guard: Keep or discard the operation draft before leaving.
release-rollouts.refresh_failed: Could not read the latest run basis. Your original draft is retained.
release-rollouts.blocker.rollout_depende: Dependency cycles prevent automatic ordered rollout.
release-rollouts.blocker.rollout_approva: Valid individual human approval is missing for the original plan.
release-rollouts.blocker.rollout_plan_ch: The original plan or current execution basis changed. Review it again.
release-rollouts.blocker.rollout_plan_ow: The original plan already belongs to another rollout. Review that run.
release-rollouts.blocker.rollout_depende: Prerequisite deployment health gates are not satisfied.
release-rollouts.blocker.rollout_operati: The original operation has an unknown result. Reconcile it before resuming.
release-rollouts.blocker.rollout_child_f: The original child run failed. A newly reviewed plan is required; blind retry is not allowed.
release-rollouts.blocker.rollout_not_pau: The run is not in a paused state that can be resumed.
release-rollouts.blocker.rollout_authori: Current authority or approval basis changed. New dispatch is paused.
release-rollouts.blocker.rollout_paused_: The operator paused new dispatch. Started runs continue to drain.
